Review Fluently: AI English coach?

Reviewers mostly say Fluently makes speaking practice easy to start anytime, with more natural conversation than many alternatives and instant feedback on grammar, pronunciation, fluency, and recurring mistakes. Several users say it helped them speak more confidently, stay engaged with varied topics, and improve over weeks or months. Still, criticism is sharp around reliability and support: some report crashes, login failures, missing expected options like accent choice, microphone issues, and a paywall immediately after assessment. One founder also noted onboarding can feel slow before personalization pays off.

#### What's great

I’ve been using Fluently AI daily for three months, and I’ve significantly improved my English during this time. I especially appreciate how my grammar mistakes are instantly highlighted on the screen — it really helps me learn faster and stay aware of my weak points. I also enjoy the wide variety of discussion topics, which makes practicing English engaging and never boring.

One small downside is the pronunciation mode — sometimes it doesn’t recognize words correctly, and I had to repeat a word multiple times before it was accepted.

Overall, the app genuinely helps improve communication skills in English, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone serious about learning.
